title: fleet_observe_common_schema.json
description: Fleet Observe v1 shared definitions (TRAIG-179, additive). Closed enums, server-issued refs, digests and counts only: no free-text field exists anywhere in this domain. Customer-chosen identifiers (principal names, workload names, labels) are content and cross only as sha256 digests. Observability is not privacy-preserving; these contracts describe what an authorized read observed within a declared boundary and period, nothing wider. Out of scope in v1 (deliberately absent): lineage edges, birth/terminal records, charters, crew tables (the crews design owns crews), builder-company path, cross-tenant federation.

ClusterRef.description: Server-issued id of an identity cluster.

AgentRef.description: Server-issued opaque reference to an agent record.

SpawnTreeRef.description: Server-issued id of a spawn tree.

ImportEventRef.description: Server-issued id of one accepted import event.

SourceRef.description: Server-issued id of a configured import source.

BoundaryRef.description: Server-issued id of a declared observation boundary (the set of accounts, clusters or gateways the read covered).

EvidenceRef.description: Server-issued id of an evidence record.

Sha256Digest.description: sha256 digest. Customer-chosen identifiers cross only in this form.

TrustLevel.description: The existing 3-value authority ceiling, kept as the derived compatibility field. A test pins this enum identical to agent_lifecycle_record/agent_lifecycle_common_schema.json#/definitions/TrustLevel. Never a substitute for EvidenceClass.

EvidenceClass.description: Evidence classes are never merged or averaged (D5). independent_observed: read by Traigent from a system the agent does not control. self_reported: declared by the agent or its runtime. lineage_internal: reported inside one spawn lineage. inherited_conditional: carried parent to child, valid only while the inheritance conditions hold. vendor_claimed: a vendor's own statement. constraint_enforced: reserved for mediated Enforce-tier routes; no Observe v1 producer.

ImportSourceKind.description: Closed list of import source kinds; the class each yields is pinned by the source-to-class table.

MemberKind.description: What an external source identifies. External sources identify principals, credentials and workloads, never agents.

ConfidenceLevel.description: Explicit clustering confidence. unknown is a first-class value, never a default of high.

RetentionClass.description: Retention rule for the retained content behind an event. ledger_minimal keeps only ids and digests after payload removal.

BoundaryKind.description: Kind of system the boundary covers.

ObservationBoundary.description: The declared boundary of an observation. A claim is 'observed within this boundary and period' (D6, D7).

ClusterMember.description: One imported principal, credential or workload, by digest of its source identifier (the identifier itself is customer content and never crosses).
